templates:
# CodexApp embedded forkless SDK ordering
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
_SORTED_SDKS = $(call __simplify,_SORTED_SDKS,$(shell "$(CA_THEOS_HELPER)" sort-versions $(_UNSORTED_SDKS)))
else
_SORTED_SDKS = $(call __simplify,_SORTED_SDKS,$(shell echo $(_UNSORTED_SDKS) | tr ' ' $$'\n' | sort -t. -k 1,1n -k 2,2n))
endif

# CodexApp embedded forkless Swift version
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
	_THEOS_TARGET_SWIFT_VERSION := 5.0
else
	_THEOS_TARGET_SWIFT_VERSION = $(call __simplify,_THEOS_TARGET_SWIFT_VERSION,$(shell $(TARGET_SWIFTC) --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d'v' -f2 | cut -d' ' -f2 | cut -d'-' -f1))
endif

# CodexApp embedded forkless clean-pwd
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
__clean_pwd = $(abspath $(1))
else
__clean_pwd = $(shell (unset CDPATH; cd "$(1)"; pwd))
endif

# CodexApp embedded forkless du capability
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
	_THEOS_PLATFORM_DU_EXCLUDE := --exclude
else
ifeq ($(shell du --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 1),1)
	_THEOS_PLATFORM_DU_EXCLUDE := --exclude
else
	_THEOS_PLATFORM_DU_EXCLUDE := -I
endif
endif

# CodexApp embedded forkless fakeroot
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
FAKEROOT := "$(CA_THEOS_HELPER)" fakeroot -p "$(_THEOS_LOCAL_DATA_DIR)/fakeroot"
else
FAKEROOT := $(_THEOS_CA_BASH) $(THEOS_BIN_PATH)/fakeroot.sh -p "$(_THEOS_LOCAL_DATA_DIR)/fakeroot"
endif

# CodexApp embedded forkless platform
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
uname_s := Darwin
uname_o := Darwin
else
uname_s := $(shell uname -s)
uname_o := $(shell uname -o 2>/dev/null)
endif

# CodexApp embedded forkless schema-key
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
override _THEOS_CLEANED_SCHEMA_SET := $(if $(filter-out DEFAULT,$(THEOS_SCHEMA)),$(shell "$(CA_THEOS_HELPER)" schema-key "$(filter-out DEFAULT,$(THEOS_SCHEMA))"),)
else
override _THEOS_CLEANED_SCHEMA_SET := $(shell echo "$(filter-out DEFAULT,$(THEOS_SCHEMA))" | tr -Cd ' A-Z' | tr ' A-Z' '_a-z')
endif

# CodexApp embedded forkless schema-uppercase
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
_THEOS_SCHEMA := $(if $(strip $(schema) $(SCHEMA)),$(shell "$(CA_THEOS_HELPER)" upper "$(strip $(schema) $(SCHEMA))"),)
else
_THEOS_SCHEMA := $(shell echo "$(strip $(schema) $(SCHEMA))" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z')
endif

# CodexApp embedded forkless target-name
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
_THEOS_TARGET_NAME_DEFINE := $(if $(filter iphone,$(THEOS_TARGET_NAME)),IPHONE,$(shell "$(CA_THEOS_HELPER)" upper "$(THEOS_TARGET_NAME)"))
else
_THEOS_TARGET_NAME_DEFINE := $(shell echo "$(THEOS_TARGET_NAME)" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z')
endif

# CodexApp embedded native compile recipes
$(THEOS_OBJ_DIR)/%.m.$(_THEOS_OBJ_FILE_TAG).o: %.m
	$(ECHO_NOTHING)mkdir -p $(dir $@)$(ECHO_END)
	$(ECHO_COMPILING)$(ECHO_UNBUFFERED)$(TARGET_CC) -x objective-c -c $(_THEOS_INTERNAL_IFLAGS_C) $(ALL_DEPFLAGS) $(ALL_CFLAGS) $(ALL_OBJCFLAGS) $< -o $@$(ECHO_END)

# CodexApp embedded native link recipes
ifeq ($$(_THEOS_CURRENT_TYPE),subproject)
	$$(ECHO_LINKING)$$(ECHO_UNBUFFERED)$$(TARGET_LIBTOOL) -static -o "$$@" $$^$$(ECHO_END)
else
	$$(ECHO_LINKING)$$(ECHO_UNBUFFERED)$$(TARGET_LD) $$(ALL_LDFLAGS) -o "$$@" $$^$$(ECHO_END)

# CodexApp embedded native shell/path
ifeq ($(CA_THEOS_EMBEDDED),1)
SHELL := $(_THEOS_CA_BASH)
ifneq ($(strip $(CA_THEOS_PATH)),)
export PATH := $(CA_THEOS_PATH):$(PATH)
endif
endif

$(THEOS_OBJ_DIR)/%.m.$(_THEOS_OBJ_FILE_TAG).o: %.m
	$(ECHO_NOTHING)mkdir -p $(dir $@)$(ECHO_END)
	$(ECHO_COMPILING)$(ECHO_UNBUFFERED)$(TARGET_CC) -x objective-c -c $(_THEOS_INTERNAL_IFLAGS_C) $(ALL_DEPFLAGS) $(ALL_CFLAGS) $(ALL_OBJCFLAGS) $< -o $@$(ECHO_END)
